content.text: No non-compete or field-of-use covenant binding us appears anywhere in the agreement. Section 2.7 restricts only copying/reverse engineering of the licensed Software (standard IP protection), the "Corio Market Segment" and "Territory" definitions are license-scope limits rather than covenants on our business, and Section 13.6 expressly preserves independent development.

input.quote: 13.6 Independent Development: Covenant not to Sue. Nothing in this Agreement will be construed to prohibit either parties' right to independently develop the Developments contemplated above.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use covenant binding Corio (our party). Section 2.7 ("Restrictions", p0042) limits only copying, reproduction and reverse engineering of the licensed Software — ordinary IP protection, not a restraint on our business. The "CORIO MARKET SEGMENT" (p0013) and "TERRITORY" (p0024) definitions merely delimit the scope of the licenses granted to us (and Section 2.10 lets us seek worldwide expansion), rather than prohibiting us from operating any business or buying/building competing products. Section 13.6 (p0117) affirmatively preserves each party's right to develop independently, and Exhibit D's sales and marketing cooperation is expressly non-binding. The only "competitor" reference (Section 14.1 assignment consent) is mutual and does not restrict our operations. This meets the preferred position — no restriction on the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build — so no redline is needed.
